title: Low-Glycemic Chicken Burrito Bowl Meal Prep
description: Using portion-controlled brown basmati rice paired with high-fiber black beans maintains a moderate GL (13.3). Greek yogurt and lean chicken breast drive a high 38g protein load, promoting GLP-1 secretion.
diabeticNotes: Using portion-controlled brown basmati rice paired with high-fiber black beans maintains a moderate GL (13.3). Greek yogurt and lean chicken breast drive a high 38g protein load, promoting GLP-1 secretion.

ingredients.name: skinless chicken breast, cubed and seasoned
cooked black beans, rinsed and drained
fresh pico de gallo (tomato, onion, cilantro, lime)

steps.title: Sear Chicken Breast
steps.description: Season diced chicken breast lightly. Sear in a skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes until cooked through.

steps.title: Build Lettuce Foundation
steps.description: Place crisp shredded Romaine lettuce across the base of a meal prep bowl.

steps.title: Add Rice & Warm Beans
steps.description: Arrange cooked brown basmati rice and rinsed black beans neatly side-by-side over lettuce.

steps.title: Top with Protein & Veggies
steps.description: Add seared chicken breast cubes, fresh cherry tomato pico, and sliced ripe avocado.

steps.title: Dollop Crema & Serve
steps.description: Finish with a dollop of Greek yogurt in the center. Enjoy immediately or chill for meal prep.
